Central: Create a new BLE central manager. The central scans for and connects to peripherals.
state: The current Bluetooth state. One of `'unknown'`, `'resetting'`, `'unsupported'`, `'unauthorized'`, `'poweredOff'`, or `'poweredOn'`.
startScan: Start scanning for peripherals. If `serviceUUIDs` is provided, only peripherals advertising those services will be discovered.
destroy: Destroy the central manager and release all resources.
PeripheralManager: Create a new BLE peripheral manager. Advertises services and handles read/write requests from centrals.
addService: Add a `service` to the manager. The service and its characteristics will be registered with the system.
respondToRequest: Respond to a read or write `request` with the given ATT `result` code. Optionally include `data` for read responses.
updateValue: Update the value of a `characteristic` and notify subscribed centrals. Returns `true` if the update was sent successfully.
unpublishChannel: Unpublish a previously published L2CAP channel identified by `psm`.
Peripheral: Represents a connected BLE peripheral. Obtained through the `'connect'` event on `Central` — not typically constructed directly.
id: The unique identifier of the peripheral.
name: The advertised name of the peripheral.
serviceData: A snapshot of the `serviceData` from the most recent advertisement seen for this peripheral before connect or `null`. Service data is only in advertisement packets, so this value never updates after connect.
discoverServices: Discover services on the peripheral. If `serviceUUIDs` is provided, only those services will be discovered.
discoverCharacteristics: Discover characteristics for a `service`. If `characteristicUUIDs` is provided, only those characteristics will be discovered.
write: Write `data` to a `characteristic`. If `withResponse` is `true` (the default), the write will be confirmed by the peripheral.
openL2CAPChannel: Open an L2CAP channel to the peripheral using the given `psm`.
characteristics: The list of characteristics belonging to the service.
primary: Whether the service is a primary service.
permissions: The bitmask of characteristic permissions, or `null` if permissions are inferred from properties.
value: The static value of the characteristic, or `null`.
L2CAPChannel: An L2CAP channel, obtained through the `'channelOpen'` event on `PeripheralManager` or `Peripheral`. Extends `Duplex` from `bare-stream` and supports standard readable and writable stream operations.
psm: The Protocol/Service Multiplexer number of the channel.
peer: The peer identifier of the channel.
PeripheralManager.ATT_UNLIKELY_ERROR: ATT result codes for use with `manager.respondToRequest()`.
